texts: On day 34 of Year 1, the harvest party returned to Cauldron Hall at dawn and carried twelve full buckets of salt-bloom.
Hesper poured the salt-bloom into the salt-bloom store.
Hesper wrote the date on each compartment of the store.

q1_issues.issue: "at dawn" sits inside the first conjunct's VP ("returned to Cauldron Hall at dawn"), and coordinated VPs share only the subject, so (Time sk_carry_1 dawn) asserts a time the text never states for the carrying.

q2_gaps: container/measure of-phrase ("twelve full buckets of salt-bloom"): a measure "of" is explicitly excluded from the genitive Possession mapping, but no positive encoding is named for it anywhere, so the container-to-contents link has no licensed form

day-of-year dating ("on day 34 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is defined as a calendar day beside (Month <name>), so a numbered day of a year (34) has no well-formed term, and an ordinal era year ("Year 1") has no form distinguishing it from a calendar year
review.notes: The distributive rule for "full" over the bucket group, the each-compartment universal with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and the stayed-potent continuation copular (Still + reified state + flat atom + tense) all match the instruction set as written. The (Day 34)/(Year 1) atoms are the only terms available, so the mis-fit is the instruction set's, not the parse's.
